requirement: Develop a customer support helpdesk ticketing CRUD system. Customers submit support tickets with priority levels and category tags, support agents assign tickets, post internal notes or public replies, and transition tickets through open, pending, resolved, and closed states.
expected_functional_reqs: CRUD for support tickets, comment threads, tags, and agent assignments
Ticket status state machine tracking first-response and resolution SLA timestamps
Internal-only agent notes hidden from customer-facing ticket views
Support queue dashboard with filters by status, priority, and assignee

tasks.title: Design tickets, ticket_comments, and sla_metrics database schema
Implement ticket CRUD, comment visibility filtering, and SLA tracking API
depends_on: Design tickets, ticket_comments, and sla_metrics database schema

tasks.title: Build agent queue workspace and ticket conversation thread UI
depends_on: Implement ticket CRUD, comment visibility filtering, and SLA tracking API

tasks.title: Audit internal note visibility and sanitize rich-text comment payloads
depends_on: Implement ticket CRUD, comment visibility filtering, and SLA tracking API

acceptance_criteria: Customer API responses never include comments marked is_internal=true
First public agent reply records the first_responded_at SLA timestamp
Reopening a resolved ticket transitions status back to open and clears resolved_at
security_reqs: Sanitize ticket body and comment HTML/Markdown against stored XSS
Prevent customers from enumerating or reading tickets owned by other users

requirement: Create a currency exchange rate aggregation and conversion REST API. Ingest daily reference exchange rates across base currencies, compute triangulated cross-currency conversion quotes with configurable basis-point spread fees, and serve historical rate range queries.
expected_functional_reqs: Exchange rate ingestion and latest quote lookup REST endpoints
Conversion calculator supporting direct and USD-triangulated currency pairs with fee breakdown
Historical time-series endpoint returning daily rates and volatility metrics over a date window
Interactive currency converter and historical rate chart UI

tasks.title: Design currency_pairs and fx_rate_snapshots database schema
Implement rate ingestion, triangulated conversion, and history REST API
depends_on: Design currency_pairs and fx_rate_snapshots database schema

tasks.title: Create currency conversion calculator and historical trend UI
depends_on: Implement rate ingestion, triangulated conversion, and history REST API

tasks.title: Write precision and inverse-rate consistency unit tests
depends_on: Implement rate ingestion, triangulated conversion, and history REST API

acceptance_criteria: Conversion endpoint returns exact Decimal gross amount, fee amount, net converted amount, and effective rate
Unsupported ISO 4217 currency codes return HTTP 400 Bad Request
Historical queries validate start_date <= end_date and cap range to 365 days
security_reqs: Reject negative or zero conversion amounts and enforce strict Decimal arithmetic
Restrict rate ingestion endpoints to authenticated admin/feed credentials

requirement: Develop a SaaS subscription billing, plan upgrade/downgrade proration, and invoice generation system. Customers subscribe to monthly or annual pricing tiers, mid-cycle tier changes calculate exact daily proration credits or charges, and webhooks update invoice payment states.
expected_functional_reqs: Pricing plan catalog and customer subscription lifecycle API (create, upgrade, downgrade, cancel)
Mid-cycle proration engine computing unused credit on old plan and remaining charge on new plan
Automated itemized invoice generation with tax rate application
Customer billing portal with plan switcher and downloadable invoice table UI

tasks.title: Design plans, subscriptions, invoices, and invoice_items database schema
Implement subscription lifecycle and mid-cycle proration calculation API
depends_on: Design plans, subscriptions, invoices, and invoice_items database schema

tasks.title: Build subscription plan comparator and invoice history UI
depends_on: Implement subscription lifecycle and mid-cycle proration calculation API

tasks.title: Verify proration credit/debit math at billing cycle boundaries
depends_on: Implement subscription lifecycle and mid-cycle proration calculation API

acceptance_criteria: Upgrading mid-cycle generates an immediate prorated adjustment invoice for the remaining days
Canceled subscriptions remain active until current_period_end when cancel_at_period_end=true
Paid invoices are locked against line-item modifications
security_reqs: Verify payment webhook signatures before marking any invoice as paid
Prevent customers from manipulating billing period timestamps or plan prices in requests

requirement: Implement a customer privacy consent manager and GDPR/CCPA data subject access request (DSAR) authentication workflow. Users manage granular marketing/analytics consent versions, require step-up re-authentication before exporting a portable JSON archive of their personal data, and request verifiable account erasure.
expected_functional_reqs: Versioned consent ledger recording opt-in/opt-out timestamps and policy versions
Step-up re-authentication gate required before initiating DSAR data export or account deletion
Portable user data export generator and anonymizing account erasure workflow
Privacy center dashboard with consent toggles and DSAR export/delete controls UI

tasks.title: Design consent_records and dsar_requests database schema
Implement consent audit API, step-up auth check, and DSAR export/erasure service
depends_on: Design consent_records and dsar_requests database schema

tasks.title: Create user privacy preferences and DSAR request portal UI
depends_on: Implement consent audit API, step-up auth check, and DSAR export/erasure service

tasks.title: Verify step-up authentication enforcement and complete PII scrubbing on erasure
depends_on: Implement consent audit API, step-up auth check, and DSAR export/erasure service

acceptance_criteria: Initiating DSAR export or account deletion without a recent (<5 min) step-up auth token returns HTTP 403
Account erasure scrubs all PII fields and revokes all active sessions while preserving anonymized audit IDs
Every consent toggle appends an immutable versioned consent history record
security_reqs: Require fresh step-up authentication within 5 minutes for data export and account erasure
Ensure exported data archives contain strictly the authenticated user's own records

requirement: Build a fleet vehicle telemetry, fuel consumption analytics, and preventive maintenance scheduling database application. Record trip odometer logs and fuel fill-ups, calculate per-vehicle miles-per-gallon (MPG) efficiency anomalies, and trigger maintenance work orders at mileage intervals.
expected_functional_reqs: Vehicle registry, trip odometer logging, and fuel receipt ingestion APIs
Monotonic odometer validation and rolling fuel-efficiency (MPG / L-per-100km) analytics queries
Automated preventive maintenance trigger when vehicle odometer crosses service intervals
Fleet efficiency leaderboard and maintenance alert dashboard UI

depends_on: Implement odometer validation, fuel efficiency analytics, and service trigger API

tasks.title: Test monotonic odometer constraints and mileage threshold triggers
depends_on: Implement odometer validation, fuel efficiency analytics, and service trigger API

acceptance_criteria: Submitting a trip log with end_odometer < current vehicle odometer returns HTTP 422
Crossing a 5,000-mile service threshold automatically creates a due maintenance record
Fleet analytics endpoint computes accurate per-vehicle MPG and flags efficiency drops > 20%
security_reqs: Authenticate driver trip submissions and prevent tampering with historical odometer records
Use parameterized queries for all fleet filtering and date-range aggregation endpoints

requirement: Develop a TOTP Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enrollment, verification, and single-use recovery code service adapted from authelia/authelia#6015. Users can enroll an authenticator app via RFC 6238 TOTP URI, verify a 6-digit code to activate MFA, generate 10 hashed backup codes, and enforce step-up MFA on sensitive actions.
expected_functional_reqs: TOTP secret provisioning endpoint returning otpauth:// URI and backup codes
Step-up MFA verification endpoint validating RFC 6238 codes with replay protection
Single-use recovery code consumption and regeneration workflow
Frontend MFA enrollment wizard and step-up challenge modal

tasks.title: Create user_mfa_secrets and mfa_recovery_codes tables with used_at tracking
Implement RFC 6238 TOTP verification and backup code redemption API
depends_on: Create user_mfa_secrets and mfa_recovery_codes tables with used_at tracking

tasks.title: Build MFA setup wizard and 6-digit OTP challenge modal UI
depends_on: Implement RFC 6238 TOTP verification and backup code redemption API

tasks.title: Verify TOTP time-step replay rejection and brute-force lockout
depends_on: Implement RFC 6238 TOTP verification and backup code redemption API

acceptance_criteria: MFA is not marked active until the user successfully verifies their first TOTP code
A TOTP code accepted once cannot be replayed within the same 30-second window
Each recovery code can be redeemed exactly once and is marked consumed
security_reqs: Lock MFA verification after 5 consecutive failed attempts for 15 minutes
Store recovery codes hashed and encrypt TOTP shared secrets at rest
